name: Friday Night at Little Longhorn
blurb: Friday Night at Little Longhorn Saloon in Allandale. Free two-step and country dancing to live music at a classic honky-tonk dive. Beginner friendly country night.

name: Honky Tonk Friday at White Horse
blurb: Honky Tonk Friday at The White Horse, East Austin. Two-step lesson early, live country bands all night. Legendary Austin honky-tonk dance floor.

name: Friday Night at Sagebrush
price_note: Cover varies by act — check sagebrushaustin.com for the week's lineup. No weekend dance lessons; lessons run Sun/Tue/Thu.
blurb: Friday Night at Sagebrush in South Austin. Country and two-step dancing with live acts, cover varies by band. Honky-tonk on South Congress.

name: Friday Night at Sam's Town Point
blurb: Friday Night at Sam's Town Point, a hidden South Austin honky-tonk. Two-step and country dancing to live music in a backyard neighborhood bar.

name: Fuego Friday
price_note: $15, $25 with classes. BYOB. Dedicated zouk side room 10pm–2am.
blurb: Fuego Friday at Blue Moon Dance Co. on South Lamar. Salsa, bachata and zouk social with classes, BYOB, dedicated zouk room late night. High energy Latin dance party.

name: Practica Buena Onda
price_note: $10 at the door, or $5 with any Connection Tango Friday class. Zelle or Venmo only.
blurb: Practica Buena Onda, Connection Tango's relaxed Friday-night Argentine tango practica at Austin Uptown Dance, 8868 Research Blvd. Work on your tango in a friendly, low-pressure setting.

name: Echale Salsita Social
price_note: See Instagram for this week's venue and cover
blurb: Echale Salsita salsa and bachata social night in Austin. Cuban salsa energy, rotating venues, check Instagram for this week's spot.
